hints: Focus on using standard enthalpies of formation, remember the rule is products minus reactants.
Notice that $\text{N}_2(\text{g})$ is an element in its standard state, so its $\Delta H_f^\ominus$ is zero, while every other species must be multiplied by its balancing number.
Calculate $4 \times \Delta H_f^\ominus(\text{H}_2\text{O})$ and $2 \times \Delta H_f^\ominus(\text{N}_2\text{H}_4)$ first, then subtract the total for reactants from the total for products.
walkthrough:
**Recall the formation enthalpy rule**

Great, this is a Hess cycle in disguise. For any reaction from formation data, use products minus reactants with full stoichiometry.

$$\Delta H_r^\ominus = \sum m\Delta H_f^\ominus(\text{products}) - \sum n\Delta H_f^\ominus(\text{reactants})$$

**Write out products total**

Products are $3\text{N}_2(\text{g}) + 4\text{H}_2\text{O}(\text{g})$. Nitrogen gas is an element, so its formation enthalpy is $0$.

$$\text{products} = 3(0) + 4(-241.8) = -967.2 \text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$$

**Write out reactants total**

Reactants are $2\text{N}_2\text{H}_4(\text{l}) + \text{N}_2\text{O}_4(\text{g})$. Do not forget to multiply the hydrazine value by 2.

$$\text{reactants} = 2(50.6) + 1(9.2) = 101.2 + 9.2 = 110.4 \text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$$

**Subtract to get reaction enthalpy**

Now finish with products minus reactants. A large negative product term minus a positive reactant term gives a strongly exothermic result.

$$\Delta H_r^\ominus = -967.2 - 110.4 = -1077.6 \text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$$

options.A: Correct. $4(-241.8) - [2(50.6) + 9.2] = -967.2 - 110.4 = -1077.6 \text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$. Stoichiometry is applied correctly and $\text{N}_2$ contributes zero.
options.B: Incorrect. This is $-967.2 + 110.4 = -856.8$. You have added the reactants total instead of subtracting it, which is the classic sign slip in products minus reactants.
options.C: Incorrect. This is $-241.8 - (50.6 + 9.2) = -301.6$. You have forgotten to multiply by the balancing numbers 4, 2 and 1, using only one mole of each species.
options.D: Incorrect. This is $-241.8 + 50.6 + 9.2 = -182.0$. You have ignored all stoichiometric coefficients and combined the values with the wrong sign, a double error.
